method: Measured main ArrayBuffers; GPU/worker memory estimates exclude hidden browser/decoder/driver heaps. Source RGB texture may use RGBA driver storage. GPU submit is CPU API time, not GPU execution. Nested analysis owner times overlap. Paint-opportunity proxy, not physical display latency. No physical iPad/Edge/hardware GPU. All timers in milliseconds. Original full diagnostic reports can be reproduced by tools/benchmark-v2-preview.mjs.
